Base directory for this skill: /Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/Tampermonkey-Scripts/.claude/skills/userscript-development

# Userscript Development

Turn a page enhancement into a maintainable script and verify it at the layer
where it will run. The repo is the source of truth; a manager is an installation
and execution target. Use the workflow in any userscript project; read
[provenance](references/provenance.md) only when tracing its source evidence.

## Scope and defaults

- Use for `.user.js` development, review, troubleshooting, and browser testing.
- Default to Tampermonkey + Violentmonkey when no target is specified; record
  this assumption. Treat Safari Userscripts and Greasemonkey as separate targets.
- Preserve the project's build system and API style. For a small new project,
  start with a plain JavaScript IIFE and a directly installable `.user.js`.
  Adopt a bundler when dependencies or project requirements justify it.
- Use browser automation as a test driver here. A scheduled crawler or a
  browser extension's background/tab-management feature needs its own workflow.
- The bundled browser example requires Node 20+ and project-pinned Playwright;
  neither is a userscript runtime dependency. Real-manager tests also need the
  relevant official extension artifacts and an isolated browser profile.

## Installed-skill contract

- Resolve `US_SKILL_ROOT` from the directory containing the loaded `SKILL.md`,
  following its symlink if needed. References and assets are relative to that
  directory, regardless of which agent or project/global installation was used.
- Run project commands from the user's selected working project. Inspect its
  package scripts and layout first; no particular upstream checkout or sibling
  repository is required.
- Treat the installed skill as read-only. Copy examples into the working project
  before installing dependencies or running them; keep outputs there too.

## Workflow

- [ ] **1. Inspect the project and choose acceptance cases.** Read its agent
  instructions, metadata validator, scripts, fixtures, and recent validation
  records. Establish target URLs, manager/browser versions, frame scope, trigger,
  expected result, and how to undo the UI change. Infer routine choices from the
  repo; ask only about missing requirements that affect behavior.
  Use only commands that exist in the current project.
- [ ] **2. Establish metadata and the execution boundary.** Preserve script
  identity and existing URL scope. Map each required capability to a declared
  grant; distinguish DOM access from page-JavaScript access. Read
  [metadata and runtime](references/metadata-and-runtime.md) when adding APIs,
  changing timing, diagnosing injection, or adding a manager target.
- [ ] **3. Make the enhancement survive the page lifecycle.** Separate the
  persistent shell from route-specific state. Make reconciliation idempotent,
  bound observers, and invalidate stale asynchronous work. Read
  [DOM lifecycle and interaction](references/dom-lifecycle.md) for SPA changes,
  hotkeys, injected UI, focus, or cleanup.
- [ ] **4. Verify the actual output.** For a reader/exporter, read
  [content extraction](references/content-extraction.md): clone before cleaning,
  exclude owned UI, preserve a snapshot, and report partial results honestly.
- [ ] **5. Run focused automated tests.** Start with syntax and project checks;
  reproduce the relevant interaction in a local fixture. Read
  [browser testing](references/browser-testing.md) for browser installation,
  test pages, deterministic GM shims, screenshots, downloads, and test matrices.
  Fix failures and rerun the affected checks.
- [ ] **6. Exercise a real manager when that layer matters.** Read
  [manager and reference-extension testing](references/extension-testing.md)
  for persistent Chromium contexts, installing through manager UI, discovering
  extension IDs, Firefox limitations, and differential/coexistence tests.
  A shim pass does not complete this step. If the environment blocks it, finish
  independent checks and record the exact unverified cases.
- [ ] **7. Prepare the deliverable.** Bump an already distributed script's
  version for a changed release; regenerate indexes with repo tools; verify the
  raw install URL and dependency revisions. Report versions and evidence using
  the template below. Publishing follows the user's requested scope.

## Choose the test layer deliberately

| Layer | What it establishes | What remains outside it |
|---|---|---|
| Syntax / metadata / pure functions | Parsing, declared capabilities, transformations | Browser behavior and installation |
| Chromium + Firefox fixture with GM shim | DOM, keyboard, routing, UI, output, modeled GM calls | Actual grants, sandbox, manager storage and updates |
| Real manager on local HTTP fixture | Installation, matching, execution, storage, manager integration | Arbitrary sites and other browser/manager versions |
| Reference extension alone / script alone / together | Native baseline, intended differences, keyboard and UI coexistence | Complete equivalence of all extension capabilities |
| Requested live-site smoke | The named interactions on that site's current DOM | All routes, accounts, or future site versions |

## Gotchas

- **A synchronous `applying` flag does not stop observer feedback.** Mutation
  callbacks arrive later. Compare the desired DOM value before writing; make a
  second reconciliation do nothing. A trailing debounce can also starve forever
  on a streaming page; use bounded scheduling where progress must continue.
- **A DOM observer is not a navigation observer.** URL-only route changes can
  have no DOM mutation. Recheck route identity on actions and use a route signal
  supported by the target environment.
- **Page context is not guaranteed by a successful Console experiment.** A new
  grant can change execution context. `document-start` is a requested timing,
  not proof that the script beat every site script or dependency load.
- **`@require` consumers own their dependencies' grants too.** Static regex
  scanners can miss calls in helpers and dynamic access; inspect dependencies.
  A local harness may substitute the worktree file while a manager uses a
  cached remote revision.
- **One init-script call preserves shim → dependency → script ordering.**
  Separate Playwright init-script registrations have no guaranteed relative
  order. Direct injection still does not reproduce the manager's timing.
- **Reference data is not a running extension.** A copied command table verifies
  a model; actual extension coexistence requires loading the extension too.
- **The first extension worker might belong to the reference extension.**
  Discover and identify each installed artifact; don't hard-code store IDs or
  assume every extension uses a Manifest V3 service worker.
- **Headless clipboard success is not a system-clipboard check.** Use a headed
  session when that behavior is required and record what was actually observed.
- **CSS isolation is not keyboard isolation.** Shadow DOM events can retarget to
  the host. Check `composedPath()`, editable ancestors, IME, and key sequences.
- **Two installed copies can look like a lifecycle bug.** Confirm script ID,
  version, manager, and whether both a URL install and local tracking copy run.
- **No API family is universally portable.** `GM_*` and `GM.*` can differ in
  availability, naming, return values, and timing. Awaiting an absent API is
  still a failure; don't advertise Safari support from desktop tests.

## Bundled assets

Copy these three files together into a project's test-example directory when
setting up its first browser harness. Read [browser testing](references/browser-testing.md)
before adapting them; they demonstrate a fixture contract, not a universal shim.

- `assets/fixture.html` — local SPA test page with an input and a replaceable main.
- `assets/fixture-tools.user.js` — small installable counter/menu demonstration.
- `assets/fixture.test.mjs` — Node test runner + Chromium/Firefox, explicit GM
  shim, route isolation, DOM and storage assertions, screenshots, cleanup.
- `assets/.gitignore` — keep the copied example's `.artifacts/` outputs out of Git.

## Handoff template

```text
Changed: <script/file; user-visible behavior; version before → after>
Targets: <manager + browser versions; URL/frame scope>
Permissions/dependencies: <added/changed capabilities and reason>
Checks:
  Static/pure: <command + result>
  Browser fixtures: <engines + cases + result>
  Real manager: <installation path + cases + result, or unverified reason>
  Reference comparison: <artifact/version + baseline/difference/coexistence>
  Live site: <specific routes/actions, or not run>
Evidence: <test page, report, screenshot, output paths>
Install/update: <artifact/raw URL; dependency and version considerations>
Remaining limits: <specific untested behavior; no inferred pass>
```

1	# Grok Markdown exporter
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	使用者希望新增類似 `userscripts/chatgpt-export-markdown/` 的 Grok 腳本，並已選擇「核心匯出」：浮動面板與 manager 選單，提供複製 Markdown、複製 Agent Handoff、下載 `.md`、下載 `.json`。

12	## 已確認的依據
13	
14	2026-10-31 已用未登入的 Chromium 實際讀取範例頁：
15	
16	- 網站透過同源 GET `/rest/app-chat/share_links/<share-id>` 取得 `{ conversation, responses }`。`message` 是原始 Markdown，另有角色、ID、時間、`partial` 與來源欄位。
17	- 此範例有一則 human、一則 assistant，含列表、表格與連結。這是「已公開的分享快照」，不代表完整私人歷史或全部分支。

21	- `webSearchResults` 是搜尋候選來源，不等於引用；此例的 `citedWebSearchResults` 為空。

````text
1	# Automated browser tests and local test pages
2	
3	Read when setting up Chromium/Firefox, adding regressions, debugging an interaction,
4	or adapting the bundled fixture harness. These tests directly inject source and
5	explicit GM shims. For actual installation, read [extension-testing.md](extension-testing.md).
6	
7	## Install the browser binaries for the project's Playwright
8	
9	Use Node 20+ for the bundled example. `playwright` works with `node:test`;
10	`@playwright/test` is not required just to drive a browser. Work from the user's
11	project root, not the skill installation directory.
12	
13	For an existing npm project that already declares Playwright, use its lockfile:
14	
15	```bash
16	npm ci
17	./node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium firefox
18	```
19	
20	For a new npm project, create `package.json` with `npm init -y` if absent, then
21	install the tested default as a development dependency:
22	
23	```bash
24	npm install --save-dev --save-exact playwright@1.62.1
25	./node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium firefox
26	```
27	
28	Keep the resulting lockfile. For a project using another package manager, retain
29	that manager and resolve its locally installed Playwright CLI. Do not borrow
30	`node_modules` from a source repository or install dependencies into the skill.
31	On supported Linux CI hosts, the local CLI's
32	`install --with-deps chromium firefox` also installs OS dependencies and can
33	require elevated package-manager access.
34	
35	If launch reports a missing executable, install the browsers for the current
36	dependency version; do not substitute an arbitrary system Chrome. Browser and
37	OS packages are separate dependencies. Report download/launch failures as setup
38	failures, never successful tests or silent skips.
39	
40	## Runnable example
41	
42	First locate the installed skill from the loaded `SKILL.md` and assign its actual
43	directory to `US_SKILL_ROOT`. Do not assume a fixed agent directory or look for the
44	author's checkout. Run the following from the working project after dependency
45	setup. The example destination must be new; preserve existing tests by choosing
46	another unused destination if necessary.
47	
48	```bash
49	(
50	  set -eu
51	  : "${US_SKILL_ROOT:?Set US_SKILL_ROOT to the loaded skill directory}"
52	  US_FIXTURE_DIR="tests/userscript-fixture"
53	  if test -e "$US_FIXTURE_DIR"; then
54	    printf '%s\n' 'Example directory exists; choose an unused destination.' >&2
55	    exit 1
56	  fi
57	  mkdir -p "$US_FIXTURE_DIR"
58	  cp "$US_SKILL_ROOT/assets/fixture.html" \
59	     "$US_SKILL_ROOT/assets/fixture-tools.user.js" \
60	     "$US_SKILL_ROOT/assets/fixture.test.mjs" \
61	     "$US_SKILL_ROOT/assets/.gitignore" "$US_FIXTURE_DIR/"
62	  node --test "$US_FIXTURE_DIR/fixture.test.mjs"
63	)
64	
65	# Subsequent single-engine runs, from the same project:
66	US_BROWSERS=chromium node --test tests/userscript-fixture/fixture.test.mjs
67	```
68	
69	The example runs both engines by default. It tests a tiny counter userscript on
70	an entirely local page: initial mount, repeated DOM changes, SPA replacement,
71	menu reset, and simulated GM storage across reload. Screenshots go to the
72	example directory's `.artifacts/`; the copied `.gitignore` excludes those outputs.
73	They can also be published as CI artifacts. This is a working pattern, not a production suite:
74	replace its script, expected UI, GM contract and assertions with the real task.
75	
76	## Build a useful fixture
77	
78	Serve a small HTML file on loopback, or fulfill requests to an explicit synthetic
79	origin through Playwright routing. A stable HTTP(S) origin enables relative URLs,
80	History calls and storage that an `about:blank` page does not model well.
81	Allow only known fixture paths and abort unexpected network requests. If a test
82	needs images/API responses, define explicit fixtures for them instead of returning
83	HTML to every request. Keep real-manager install traffic out of these mocks.
84	
85	Choose cases relevant to the change:
86	
87	| Case | Fixture behavior / assertion |
88	|---|---|
89	| Mount race | Target absent initially, inserted later; exactly one tool appears |
90	| SPA | Replace main; also change URL without DOM changes; no stale state |
91	| DOM reuse | Remove owned UI but retain parent, then reconcile |
92	| Streaming | Repeated small changes; bounded updates, no starvation/feedback |
93	| Keyboard | Inputs, nested contenteditable, open shadow input, site capture listener, repeats and modifiers |
94	| Reader/export | Known paragraphs/code/table, relative/lazy images, owned UI and translation sentinels |
95	| Download | Success, error/login body, timeout, cancellation, duplicate names |
96	| Layout | Light/dark, narrow viewport, long labels, nested scroll containers |
97	
98	Include stable element IDs and expected content. Inspect the resulting screenshot
99	and text artifacts; assertions alone cannot establish layout quality.
100	
101	## Inject in a known order
102	
103	Read the actual delivered userscript and resolved `@require` files from disk.
104	Provide shim, dependencies and source in **one** `context.addInitScript({content})`
105	call, in that order. Separate init-script registrations have unspecified ordering.
106	For a post-DOM mount test, explicitly inject at that phase; neither approach
107	proves that a manager honors the script's `@run-at` under real conditions.
108	
109	Model only the APIs needed by this script and their real sync/async shape. Missing
110	APIs should fail visibly. Capture menu callbacks, clipboard values, requested tabs,
111	storage writes, downloads, and unexpected calls. Implement failure cases relevant
112	to the task; do not stub every API as a no-op and then infer compatibility.
113	
114	localStorage can simulate reload persistence in a same-origin fixture. Label that
115	as a shim; GM storage can span origins and has different isolation/change semantics.
116	
117	## Drive and observe the interaction
118	
119	- Use Playwright `locator.click()`, keyboard, pointer and focus operations.
120	  Calling a callback directly is appropriate for a shim menu contract, but does
121	  not verify the manager menu's UI.
122	- Use keyboard typing for shortcut conflicts. Synthetic composition events can
123	  test a handler's guards, not OS IME end-to-end behavior.
124	- Register page errors and request failures before navigation. Save a screenshot
125	  and relevant state on failure as well as on success.
126	- Wait for state/locators/outputs with a bounded timeout. Fixed sleeps can conceal
127	  races; a longer sleep is not a correctness assertion.
128	- Start `waitForEvent('download')` before the triggering click, save and inspect
129	  the file. Wait for clipboard output before reading it.
130	- Use independent contexts per test unless persistence/coexistence is the case.
131	  Close browsers, contexts and local servers in finally/teardown paths.
132	
133	For pure transformations, test exported modules or the exact pure-function region
134	from the delivered `.user.js`; do not maintain a test-only copy of the algorithm.
135	Fixtures derived from an external reference must retain version, source URL and
136	artifact hash. Agreement with such data is a model check, not a live comparison.
137	
138	## Official references
139	
140	- [Playwright browsers](https://playwright.dev/docs/browsers)
141	- [BrowserContext.addInitScript ordering](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-add-init-script)
142	- [Playwright downloads](https://playwright.dev/docs/downloads)
143	- [Node test runner](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html)
144	
145	Reviewed 2026-09-09. Real-manager evidence is deliberately separate.
146
````

````text
1	# Content extraction and export
2	
3	Read for Markdown exporters, article readers, selections, or attachment archives.
4	
5	## Define the extraction contract first
6	
7	State whether output covers selected content, currently loaded DOM, or a complete
8	document/history. Virtualized lists, pagination, collapsed regions and a late
9	capture can yield only partial content. Label fallback output accordingly.
10	Do not promote a partial cache merely because it contains some valid records.
11	
12	Keep adapters for changing site selectors/data shapes separate from generic
13	conversion, clipboard/download delivery, and UI. Invalidate cached content on
14	route identity changes; don't reuse data from another article/conversation.
15	
16	## Extract → snapshot → render
17	
18	1. Capture source metadata and route identity before opening the reader.
19	2. Clone the source DOM. Preserve selected image URLs (`currentSrc`, applicable
20	   lazy-loading attributes) and resolve relative links against the source base
21	   while that context is still available.
22	3. Clean the clone: remove owned panels, menus, hints and known injected noise.
23	   Handle translation wrappers explicitly; do not delete the only surviving
24	   original text just because an extension hides it.
25	4. Extract semantic content. If a readability algorithm loses code blocks or
26	   structured documentation, use a checked semantic container or user selection.
27	5. Sanitize HTML before displaying it. Convert the preserved source snapshot to
28	   Markdown; don't re-extract from the reader after another extension translates
29	   or mutates it.
30	6. Preserve tables, code languages/fences, lists and links. Inspect the resulting
31	   text/file, not just the UI screenshot.
32	
33	A useful regression inserts an unmistakable sentinel into owned UI and a
34	translation wrapper, then asserts it is absent from exported Markdown. Also
35	assert the source page's HTML/scroll/overflow survive opening and closing a reader.
36	
37	## Downloads and partial failure
38	
39	- Keep Markdown-only and attachment-archive operations separate: the former
40	  need not initiate every image/document request.
41	- Bound concurrency, per-file/total size, timeout, and cancellation. Report
42	  per-item failure without discarding successful content.
43	- Check response status, content type and recognizable error/login responses;
44	  a `.pdf` path alone does not establish that the downloaded bytes are a PDF.
45	- Deduplicate resources, sanitize output names and prevent filename collisions.
46	  Rewrite only successfully saved resources to local relative paths; leave
47	  failed links remote and report incomplete offline coverage.
48	- Register Playwright's download listener before clicking. Inspect saved bytes,
49	  archive members and rewritten links in addition to observing an event.
50	- A signed URL on another host (CDN/blob storage) usually answers
51	  `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, which rejects `credentials: 'include'`. Send
52	  cookies only to same-origin URLs; a fixture should return `ACAO: *` so the
53	  browser enforces this. Treat query strings on asset pointers as API
54	  parameters, not as part of the file id.
55	- Detect binary data with `ArrayBuffer.isView` / `Object.prototype.toString`,
56	  not `instanceof Uint8Array`: buffers from page `fetch` can come from another
57	  realm (manager sandbox, iframe, `vm` test context).
58	- A hand-written ZIP with UTF-8 names needs general-purpose bit 11 and a
59	  Unix "version made by" host. With an MS-DOS host, Info-ZIP ignores the flag
60	  and decodes names as an OEM code page. Check with an independent reader:
61	  parse the central directory and verify the CRCs.
62	
63	When an exporter replaces placeholders from site metadata (citation refs,
64	widgets), check that each replacement is readable text. A new ref type with a
65	`null`/empty `alt` can cover a whole code block. Keep the original text for
66	unknown or empty replacements, and look at the raw payload's new `metadata`
67	keys before you change the renderer.
68	
69	Example evidence shape (adapt to the project):
70	
71	```json
72	{
73	  "scope": "loaded-dom",
74	  "complete": false,
75	  "saved": 3,
76	  "failed": 1,
77	  "failures": [{ "url": "https://example.com/image.png", "reason": "timeout" }]
78	}
79	```
80	
81	If another page/service receives extracted content, make the destination and
82	action visible. Preparing content and sending it are separate user actions;
83	test against a local receiver when verifying the contract.
84	
85	## Source examples
86	
87	- Reader snapshot, image handling, archive tests: [provenance](provenance.md).
88	- General browser fixtures and download assertions: [browser-testing.md](browser-testing.md).
89

184	/** `<source>-<標題>-<YYYYMMDD-HHmm>.<ext>`，檔名不合法的字元一律拿掉。 */
185	function filenameFor(doc, extension) {
186	  const slug =
187	    String(doc.title || 'conversation')
188	      .replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '')
189	      .trim()
190	      .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
191	      .slice(0, 60) || 'conversation';
192	  const now = new Date();
193	  const stamp =
194	    `${now.getFullYear()}${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(now.getDate())}-` +
195	    `${pad(now.getHours())}${pad(now.getMinutes())}`;
196	  return `${doc.source}-${slug}-${stamp}.${extension}`;
197	}
198	
199	/** 不需要任何 @grant 的檔案下載。 */
200	function downloadBlob(filename, blob) {
201	  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
202	  const a = document.createElement('a');
203	  a.href = url;
204	  a.download = filename;
205	  a.click();
206	  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
207	}
208	
209	/** 同 shared/dom.js 的 downloadText。 */
210	function downloadText(filename, text, mime = 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8') {
211	  downloadBlob(filename, new Blob([text], { type: mime }));
212	}
213

import { after, before, describe, it } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { chromium, firefox } from 'playwright';

const read = (path) => readFile(new URL(`../${path}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const [SCRIPT, SHARED, UI, SHARE, DOM, PLACEHOLDERS] = await Promise.all([
  read('userscripts/grok-export-markdown/grok-export-markdown.user.js'),
  read('shared/chat-export.js'),
  read('shared/export-ui.js'),
  read('tests/fixtures/grok-export/share.json'),
  read('tests/fixtures/grok-export/conversation.html'),
  read('tests/fixtures/grok-export/placeholders.html'),
]);
const ORIGIN = 'https://grok.com';
const SHARE_ID = 'bGVnYWN5_fixture-id';
const SHARE_URL = `${ORIGIN}/share/${SHARE_ID}`;
const API_URL = `${ORIGIN}/rest/app-chat/share_links/${SHARE_ID}`;
const ROOT = '#grok-export-md-root';
const PANEL = '#grok-export-md-panel';
const EMPTY = '<!doctype html><html><head><title>Empty fixture</title><link rel="icon" href="data:,"></head><body><nav>OUTSIDE_CONVERSATION_SENTINEL</nav><main id="conversation"></main></body></html>';
const ACTIONS = ['Copy Markdown', 'Copy Agent Handoff', 'Download .md', 'Download .json'];
const ENGINES = { chromium, firefox };
const selected = (process.env.GROK_BROWSERS || 'chromium,firefox').split(',').map((name) => name.trim());
for (const name of selected) assert.ok(ENGINES[name], `Unknown GROK_BROWSERS engine: ${name}`);

function gmShim() {
  const storage = Object.create(null);
  window.__gmMenus = Object.create(null);
  window.__gmMenuNames = [];
  window.__gmClipboard = [];
  window.__gmWrites = [];
  window.__downloadBlobs = [];
  window.GM_getValue = (key, fallback) => key in storage ? storage[key] : fallback;
  window.GM_setValue = (key, value) => {
    storage[key] = value;
    window.__gmWrites.push({ key, value });
  };
  window.GM_registerMenuCommand = (label, callback) => {
    window.__gmMenuNames.push(label);
    window.__gmMenus[label] = callback;
  };
  window.GM_setClipboard = (text, type) => window.__gmClipboard.push({ text, type });
  // 只觀察 MIME／size；保留真正 Blob URL 與瀏覽器下載流程。
  const create = URL.createObjectURL.bind(URL);
  URL.createObjectURL = (blob) => {
    window.__downloadBlobs.push({ type: blob.type, size: blob.size });
    return create(blob);
  };
}

function scope(markdown, exportScope, completeness) {
  const match = markdown.match(/^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---\n/);
  assert.ok(match, 'frontmatter must start the delivered Markdown');
  assert.match(match[1], /^source: grok$/m);
  assert.match(match[1], new RegExp(`^export_scope: ["']?${exportScope}["']?$`, 'm'));
  assert.match(match[1], new RegExp(`^completeness: ["']?${completeness}["']?$`, 'm'));
  const body = markdown.slice(match[0].length);
  if (exportScope === 'published-share-snapshot') {
    assert.match(body, /公開|published|public/i, 'share limitation must be visible outside frontmatter');
    assert.match(body, /快照|snapshot/i);
    assert.match(body, /不保證|不代表|not guarantee|not necessarily|private history/i);
  } else {
    assert.match(body, /已載入|loaded/i, 'DOM limitation must be visible outside frontmatter');
    assert.match(body, /缺漏|不完整|可能遺漏|未載入|partial|missing|incomplete/i);
  }
}

function shareContent(markdown, completeness = 'unknown') {
  scope(markdown, 'published-share-snapshot', completeness);
  assert.match(markdown, /^messages: 4$/m);
  const terms = ['FIRST QUESTION', 'FIRST ANSWER', 'FOLLOWUP QUESTION', 'FOLLOWUP ANSWER'];
  const positions = terms.map((text) => markdown.indexOf(text));
  assert.ok(positions.every((at, i) => at >= 0 && (!i || at > positions[i - 1])), 'retain API order, not timestamps');
  assert.equal((markdown.match(/_\*\*User\b/g) || []).length, 2);
  assert.equal((markdown.match(/_\*\*Assistant\b/g) || []).length, 2);
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('| Item | Value |\n| --- | --- |\n| A | 42 |'));
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('```js\nconst value = 42;\n```'));
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('$$x^2 + y^2$$'));
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('[Remote document](https://example.com/document)'));
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('[Cited reference](https://example.com/cited)'));
  assert.equal(markdown.split('https://example.com/cited').length - 1, 1);
  assert.doesNotMatch(markdown, /CONTROL_SENTINEL|TOOL_SENTINEL|THINKING_SENTINEL|UNKNOWN_ROLE_SENTINEL|CANDIDATE_ONLY|uncited-candidate|OUTSIDE_CONVERSATION_SENTINEL/);
}

function domContent(markdown) {
  scope(markdown, 'loaded-dom', 'partial');
  assert.match(markdown, /^messages: 2$/m);
  assert.ok(markdown.indexOf('DOM QUESTION') < markdown.indexOf('DOM ANSWER'));
  for (const text of ['## DOM ANSWER', '**Bold value**', '*emphasis*', '> Quoted value', 'Nested item']) {
    assert.ok(markdown.includes(text), `missing DOM semantic content: ${text}`);
  }
  assert.match(markdown, /1\. First item/);
  assert.match(markdown, /2\. Second item/);
  assert.match(markdown, /\|\s*Item\s*\|\s*Value\s*\|/);
  assert.match(markdown, /\|\s*Alpha\s*\|\s*42\s*\|/);
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('[Relative document](https://grok.com/docs/fixture)'));
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('![Synthetic diagram](https://grok.com/assets/fixture.svg)'));
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('$x + 1$'));
  const code = markdown.match(/(`{4,}|~{3,})js\n([\s\S]*?)\n\1/);
  assert.ok(code, 'embedded triple backticks need a longer or alternate code fence');
  assert.ok(code[2].includes("const ticks = '```';\n  console.log(ticks);"));
  assert.doesNotMatch(markdown, /SENTINEL|Copy Markdown|Copy Agent Handoff|Download \.md|Download \.json/);
}

function envelope(text, url) {
  const data = JSON.parse(text);
  assert.equal(data.source, 'grok');
  assert.equal(data.schema, 'grok-loaded-dom-v1');
  assert.equal(data.url, url);
  assert.equal(data.export_scope, 'loaded-dom');
  assert.equal(data.completeness, 'partial');
  assert.ok(data.title);
  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(Date.parse(data.capturedAt)), 'capture timestamp must be parseable');
  assert.equal(data.messages.length, 2);
  assert.equal(new Set(data.messages.map((message) => message.id)).size, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(data.messages.map((message) => message.role.toLowerCase()), ['user', 'assistant']);
  for (const message of data.messages) {
    assert.ok(message.id);
    assert.ok(message.parts.length);
    for (const part of message.parts) {
      assert.ok(['markdown', 'html'].includes(part.format));
      assert.equal(typeof part.content, 'string');
      assert.doesNotMatch(part.content, /SENTINEL|Copy Markdown|Download \.json/);
    }
  }
  return data;
}

function deferred() {
  let resolve;
  const promise = new Promise((done) => { resolve = done; });
  return { promise, resolve };
}

function bubble(id, text, role = 'user') {
  return `<section id="response-${id}"><div data-testid="${role}-message"><div class="response-content-markdown"><p>${text}</p></div></div></section>`;
}

for (const engineName of selected) {
  describe(`${engineName} Grok black-box exports (GM shim)`, { timeout: 35000 }, () => {
    let browser;
    before(async () => { browser = await ENGINES[engineName].launch({ headless: true }); });
    after(async () => { await browser?.close(); });

    async function open(t, { url = SHARE_URL, html = EMPTY, data = JSON.parse(SHARE), api } = {}) {
      const context = await browser.newContext({ acceptDownloads: true, serviceWorkers: 'block' });
      const page = await context.newPage();
      page.setDefaultTimeout(8000);
      const errors = [];
      const consoleMessages = [];
      const unexpected = [];
      const requests = [];
      const failures = [];
      const downloads = [];
      page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
      page.on('console', (message) => consoleMessages.push({ type: message.type(), text: message.text() }));
      page.on('requestfailed', (request) => failures.push({ url: request.url(), error: request.failure()?.errorText }));
      page.on('download', (download) => downloads.push(download));
      await context.route('**/*', async (route) => {
        const request = route.request();
        if (request.url() === url && request.resourceType() === 'document' && request.method() === 'GET') {
          return route.fulfill({ contentType: 'text/html', body: html });
        }
        if (request.url() === API_URL && request.method() === 'GET') {
          requests.push(request.url());
          return api ? api(route) : route.fulfill({ json: data });
        }
        if (request.url() === `${ORIGIN}/assets/fixture.svg` && request.resourceType() === 'image') {
          return route.fulfill({ contentType: 'image/svg+xml', body: '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="2" height="2"><rect width="2" height="2"/></svg>' });
        }
        unexpected.push(`${request.method()} ${request.url()}`);
        return route.abort();
      });
      // 單一 init bundle 的順序固定；不替換 adapter、renderer、UI 或下載函式。
      await context.addInitScript({ content: `(${gmShim})();\n${SHARED}\n${UI}\n${SCRIPT}` });
      t.after(async () => {
        await context.close();
        assert.deepEqual(errors, [], JSON.stringify(consoleMessages));
        assert.deepEqual(unexpected, [], 'fixture must not access any other network route');
      });
      await page.goto(url);
      await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__gmMenuNames.length === 5);
      assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(() => [...window.__gmMenuNames].sort()), [...ACTIONS, 'Reset button position'].sort());

      const menu = (label) => page.evaluate(async (name) => {
        const run = window.__gmMenus[name];
        if (!run) throw new Error(`Missing GM menu: ${name}`);
        await run();
      }, label);
      async function action(label, transport = 'menu') {
        if (transport === 'menu') return menu(label);
        if (!(await page.locator(PANEL).isVisible())) await page.locator(`${ROOT} > button`).click();
        await page.locator(PANEL).getByRole('button', { name: label, exact: true }).click();
      }
      async function copy(label = 'Copy Markdown', transport = 'menu') {
        const count = await page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard.length);
        await action(label, transport);
        await page.waitForFunction((previous) => window.__gmClipboard.length > previous, count);
        return page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard.at(-1).text);
      }
      async function download(extension, transport = 'menu') {
        const ready = page.waitForEvent('download');
        await action(`Download .${extension}`, transport);
        const file = await ready;
        assert.equal(await file.failure(), null);
        assert.match(file.suggestedFilename(), new RegExp(`^grok-.+\\.${extension}$`));
        const chunks = [];
        for await (const chunk of await file.createReadStream()) chunks.push(chunk);
        const bytes = Buffer.concat(chunks);
        assert.ok(bytes.length);
        const blob = await page.evaluate(() => window.__downloadBlobs.at(-1));
        assert.equal(blob.size, bytes.length);
        assert.equal(blob.type, extension === 'json' ? 'application/json;charset=utf-8' : 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8');
        return bytes.toString('utf8');
      }
      return { page, menu, copy, download, requests, failures, downloads, consoleMessages };
    }

    for (const transport of ['menu', 'panel']) {
      it(`executes all four ${transport} actions with exact underscore share ID and scope notices`, async (t) => {
        const data = JSON.parse(SHARE);
        const original = JSON.stringify(data);
        const app = await open(t, { data });
        const markdown = await app.copy('Copy Markdown', transport);
        shareContent(markdown);
        assert.doesNotMatch(markdown, /# Prior Grok Context/);
        const handoff = await app.copy('Copy Agent Handoff', transport);
        shareContent(handoff);
        assert.match(handoff, /# Prior Grok Context/);
        shareContent(await app.download('md', transport));
        assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(await app.download('json', transport)), data);
        assert.equal(JSON.stringify(data), original);
        assert.ok(app.requests.length > 0);
        assert.ok(app.requests.every((url) => url === API_URL));
        assert.equal(await app.page.locator(ROOT).count(), 1);
        await app.menu('Reset button position');
        const reset = await app.page.evaluate(() => ({ value: window.__gmWrites.at(-1)?.value, style: document.querySelector('#grok-export-md-root').style.cssText }));
        assert.equal(reset.value, null);
        assert.match(reset.style, /right: 16px/);
        assert.match(reset.style, /bottom: 16px/);
      });
    }

    it('marks partial responses without exporting controls, steps, unknown roles or search candidates', async (t) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(SHARE);
      data.responses[1].partial = true;
      const app = await open(t, { data });
      shareContent(await app.copy(), 'partial');
      assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(await app.download('json')), data);
    });

    it('recovers unchanged raw JSON when an unsupported message object cannot render', async (t) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(SHARE);
      data.responses = [{ responseId: 'unsupported', sender: 'assistant', message: { futureFormat: ['OPAQUE_SENTINEL'] } }];
      const app = await open(t, { data });
      await app.menu('Copy Markdown');
      assert.deepEqual(await app.page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard), []);
      const diagnostics = await app.page.locator(PANEL).textContent();
      assert.match(`${diagnostics}\n${app.consoleMessages.map((entry) => entry.text).join('\n')}`, /不支援|無法|沒有可匯出|未知|unsupported|unknown|render/i);
      assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(await app.download('json')), data);
      assert.equal(app.downloads.length, 1);
    });

    for (const failure of ['http', 'json']) {
      it(`falls back to same-share DOM after ${failure} failure, with honest JSON and Markdown scope`, async (t) => {
        const app = await open(t, {
          html: DOM,
          api: (route) => route.fulfill(failure === 'http'
            ? { status: 503, json: { error: 'fixture unavailable' } }
            : { contentType: 'application/json', body: '{invalid-json' }),
        });
        domContent(await app.copy());
        scope(await app.copy('Copy Agent Handoff'), 'loaded-dom', 'partial');
        envelope(await app.download('json'), SHARE_URL);
        assert.ok(app.requests.length > 0);
      });
    }

    it('exports DOM-only semantics and cleaned snapshots without changing the source or requesting private APIs', async (t) => {
      const url = `${ORIGIN}/c/fixture`;
      const app = await open(t, { url, html: DOM });
      const original = await app.page.locator('#conversation').innerHTML();
      domContent(await app.copy());
      const handoff = await app.copy('Copy Agent Handoff');
      domContent(handoff);
      assert.match(handoff, /# Prior Grok Context/);
      domContent(await app.download('md', 'panel'));
      const json = envelope(await app.download('json', 'panel'), url);
      assert.ok(json.messages[0].id.endsWith('dom-user'));
      assert.ok(json.messages[1].id.endsWith('dom-assistant'));
      assert.ok(json.messages[1].parts.some((part) => part.format === 'html' && part.content.includes('<table')));
      assert.equal(await app.page.locator('#conversation').innerHTML(), original, 'cleanup must affect clones only');
      assert.equal(await app.page.getByRole('button', { name: 'COPY_TABLE_SENTINEL', exact: true }).count(), 1);
      assert.deepEqual(app.requests, []);
    });

    it('keeps sole raw placeholders and prefers rendered content without duplicate conversion', async (t) => {
      const url = `${ORIGIN}/c/fixture`;
      const app = await open(t, { url, html: PLACEHOLDERS });
      const original = await app.page.locator('#conversation').innerHTML();
      const markdown = await app.copy();
      scope(markdown, 'loaded-dom', 'partial');
      assert.ok(markdown.includes('```md\n# This is code, not a heading\n```'));
      assert.ok(markdown.includes('- raw list value'));
      assert.equal(markdown.split('RENDERED ANSWER').length - 1, 1);
      assert.ok(markdown.includes('**RENDERED ANSWER**'));
      assert.doesNotMatch(markdown, /RAW_DUPLICATE_SENTINEL/);
      const json = envelope(await app.download('json'), url);
      assert.equal(json.messages[0].parts[0].format, 'markdown');
      assert.ok(json.messages[0].parts[0].content.includes('```md'));
      assert.equal(json.messages[1].parts[0].format, 'html');
      assert.equal(await app.page.locator('#conversation').innerHTML(), original);
      assert.deepEqual(app.requests, []);
    });

    it('waits for delayed message mount instead of scraping the whole body', async (t) => {
      const app = await open(t, { url: `${ORIGIN}/c/fixture` });
      const pending = app.copy();
      await app.page.evaluate((html) => { document.querySelector('#conversation').innerHTML = html; }, bubble('delayed', 'DELAYED MOUNT CONTENT'));
      const markdown = await pending;
      scope(markdown, 'loaded-dom', 'partial');
      assert.ok(markdown.includes('DELAYED MOUNT CONTENT'));
      assert.doesNotMatch(markdown, /OUTSIDE_CONVERSATION_SENTINEL/);
      assert.equal(await app.page.locator(ROOT).count(), 1);
      assert.deepEqual(app.requests, []);
    });

    it('mounts once on home-to-conversation SPA navigation and refuses unsupported routes', async (t) => {
      const app = await open(t, { url: `${ORIGIN}/` });
      assert.equal(await app.page.locator(ROOT).isVisible(), false);
      await app.page.evaluate((html) => {
        history.pushState({}, '', '/c/fixture');
        document.querySelector('#conversation').innerHTML = html;
      }, bubble('spa-user', 'SPA MOUNT CONTENT'));
      await app.page.locator(ROOT).waitFor({ state: 'visible' });
      assert.ok((await app.copy()).includes('SPA MOUNT CONTENT'));
      await app.page.evaluate(() => {
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) document.querySelector('#conversation').append(document.createElement('span'));
      });
      assert.equal(await app.page.locator(ROOT).count(), 1);
      await app.page.evaluate(() => history.pushState({}, '', '/settings'));
      await app.page.locator(ROOT).waitFor({ state: 'hidden' });
      const copies = await app.page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard.length);
      await app.menu('Copy Markdown');
      assert.equal(await app.page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard.length), copies);
      assert.equal(app.downloads.length, 0);
      assert.deepEqual(app.requests, []);
    });

    it('rejects old bubbles on URL-only navigation, including mixed old/new DOM, then accepts replacement', async (t) => {
      const app = await open(t, { url: `${ORIGIN}/c/fixture`, html: DOM });
      await app.page.locator(ROOT).waitFor({ state: 'visible' });
      await app.page.evaluate(() => history.pushState({}, '', '/c/replacement'));
      const pending = app.copy();
      // 負向時窗跨越兩次 250ms route tick，確認舊泡泡不會被立即交付。
      await app.page.waitForTimeout(550);
      assert.deepEqual(await app.page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard), []);
      await app.page.evaluate((html) => { document.querySelector('#conversation').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html); }, bubble('new-route-user', 'REPLACEMENT CONTENT'));
      await app.page.waitForTimeout(550);
      assert.deepEqual(await app.page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard), [], 'new IDs do not make retained old nodes safe');
      await app.page.evaluate(() => {
        document.querySelector('#response-dom-user').remove();
        document.querySelector('#response-dom-assistant').remove();
      });
      const markdown = await pending;
      assert.ok(markdown.includes('REPLACEMENT CONTENT'));
      assert.doesNotMatch(markdown, /DOM QUESTION|DOM ANSWER|SENTINEL/);
      assert.match(markdown, /^url:.*\/c\/replacement/m);
      assert.deepEqual(app.requests, []);
    });

    for (const label of ['Copy Markdown', 'Download .json']) {
      it(`cancels pending share ${label} on navigation without stale output`, async (t) => {
        const entered = deferred();
        const release = deferred();
        t.after(() => release.resolve());
        const app = await open(t, {
          api: async (route) => {
            entered.resolve();
            await release.promise;
            await route.fulfill({ json: JSON.parse(SHARE) });
          },
        });
        const pending = app.menu(label);
        await entered.promise;
        const aborted = app.page.waitForEvent('requestfailed', { predicate: (request) => request.url() === API_URL });
        await app.page.evaluate((html) => {
          history.pushState({}, '', '/c/replacement');
          document.querySelector('#conversation').innerHTML = html;
        }, bubble('after-request', 'CURRENT ROUTE CONTENT'));
        await aborted;
        await pending;
        assert.deepEqual(await app.page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard), []);
        assert.equal(app.downloads.length, 0);
        const current = await app.copy();
        assert.ok(current.includes('CURRENT ROUTE CONTENT'));
        release.resolve();
        await app.page.waitForTimeout(300);
        assert.equal(await app.page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard.length), 1);
        assert.equal(app.downloads.length, 0);
        assert.doesNotMatch(await app.page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard.at(-1).text), /FIRST ANSWER|FIRST QUESTION/);
      });
    }

    it('bounds a hanging share fetch and uses loaded-DOM fallback after timeout', async (t) => {
      const release = deferred();
      t.after(() => release.resolve());
      const app = await open(t, {
        html: DOM,
        api: async (route) => {
          await release.promise;
          await route.fulfill({ json: JSON.parse(SHARE) });
        },
      });
      app.page.setDefaultTimeout(20000);
      const markdown = await app.copy();
      domContent(markdown);
      assert.ok(app.failures.some((failure) => failure.url === API_URL), 'timeout aborts the underlying request');
      assert.equal(await app.page.evaluate(() => window.__gmClipboard.length), 1);
      release.resolve();
    });
  });
}

35	  const DOM_NOTICE = '此匯出僅包含目前已載入的頁面訊息；未載入、收合或虛擬化內容可能缺漏。';
36	  const NOISE = [
37	    `[id^="${NS}"]`, '[data-no-copy="true"]', '.thinking-container',
38	    'script', 'style', 'svg', 'button', '[role="button"]', 'input', 'textarea',
39	    'select', 'form', 'nav', '[data-code-block-header]',
40	  ].join(',');
41	
42	  const panel = createExportPanel({
43	    ns: NS,
44	    buttonLabel: '⇩ Export MD',
45	    actions: [
46	      { label: 'Copy Markdown', run: () => doExport('markdown') },
47	      { label: 'Copy Agent Handoff', run: () => doExport('handoff') },
48	      { label: 'Download .md', run: () => doExport('md') },
49	      { label: 'Download .json', run: () => doExport('json') },
50	    ],
51	    storage: { get: (key, fallback) => GM_getValue(key, fallback), set: (key, value) => GM_setValue(key, value) },
52	    onStatus: (text) => console.log('[grok-export-markdown]', text),
53	  });
54	
55	  // 只保留目前頁面節點的 identity，不快取其他對話的正文。
56	  let route = readRoute();
57	  let routeKey = currentKey();
58	  let generation = 0;
59	  let operation = null;
60	  let lastMessages = [];
61	  let staleMessages = [];
62	  let reconcileTimer = null;
63	
64	  function readRoute() {
65	    const match = location.pathname.match(/^\/(share|c)\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\/?$/);
66	    if (!match) return null;
67	    return { kind: match[1], id: match[2], url: `${location.origin}/${match[1]}/${match[2]}` };
68	  }
69	
70	  function currentKey() {
71	    return readRoute()?.url || `${location.origin}${location.pathname}`;
72	  }
73	
74	  function messageNodes() {
75	    return [...document.querySelectorAll(MESSAGE_SELECTOR)].filter((node) => !node.closest(`[id^="${NS}"]`));
76	  }
77	
78	  function responseId(node) {
79	    return node.closest('[id^="response-"]')?.id.slice('response-'.length) || '';
80	  }
81	
82	  function staleNode(node) {
83	    const id = responseId(node);
84	    return staleMessages.some((old) => (id && old.id === id) || (old.node === node && (!id || !old.id)));
85	  }
86	
87	  function updateRoute() {
88	    const key = currentKey();
89	    if (key === routeKey) return;
90	    operation?.controller.abort();
91	    operation = null;
92	    generation += 1;
93	    staleMessages = lastMessages;
94	    lastMessages = [];
95	    routeKey = key;
96	    route = readRoute();
97	    panel.setStatus(route ? '已切換頁面，請等目前對話載入後匯出。' : '請開啟 Grok 分享頁或 /c/ 對話頁。');
98	  }
99	
100	  function reconcile() {
101	    reconcileTimer = null;
102	    updateRoute();
103	    const nodes = messageNodes();
104	    if (!nodes.some(staleNode)) lastMessages = nodes.map((node) => ({ node, id: responseId(node) }));
105	    if (!document.body) return;
106	    if (route) panel.mount();
107	    const root = document.getElementById(`${NS}-root`);
108	    if (root && root.hidden !== !route) root.hidden = !route;
109	  }
110	
111	  function scheduleReconcile() {
112	    // 固定上限，不讓 streaming 每個 token 都重新延後工作。
113	    updateRoute();
114	    if (reconcileTimer === null) reconcileTimer = setTimeout(reconcile, 100);
115	  }
116	
117	  function assertCurrent(op) {
118	    updateRoute();
119	    if (operation !== op || generation !== op.generation || op.controller.signal.aborted) {
120	      throw new DOMException('頁面或匯出操作已變更。', 'AbortError');
121	    }
122	  }
123	
124	  function delay(ms, signal) {
125	    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
126	      const abort = () => {
127	        clearTimeout(timer);
128	        reject(new DOMException('匯出已取消。', 'AbortError'));
129	      };
130	      const timer = setTimeout(() => { signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort); resolve(); }, ms);
131	      signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
132	      if (signal.aborted) abort();
133	    });
134	  }
135	
136	  async function fromShare(op) {
137	    const controller = new AbortController();
138	    const abort = () => controller.abort();
139	    op.controller.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
140	    const timer = setTimeout(abort, FETCH_TIMEOUT);
141	    try {
142	      const response = await fetch(`${location.origin}/rest/app-chat/share_links/${encodeURIComponent(op.route.id)}`, {
143	        credentials: 'same-origin', signal: controller.signal, headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
144	      });
145	      assertCurrent(op);
146	      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`分享 API HTTP ${response.status}`);
147	      if (!/\bapplication\/(?:[\w.-]+\+)?json\b/i.test(response.headers.get('content-type') || '')) {
148	        throw new Error('分享 API 未回傳 JSON（可能是登入或驗證頁）。');
149	      }
150	      const data = await response.json();
151	      assertCurrent(op);
152	      // 不要求 Markdown schema 完全可解析，讓 JSON 仍能作為格式改版時的救援。
153	      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data) || data.error || data.errors ||
154	          (!Object.hasOwn(data, 'responses') && !Object.hasOwn(data, 'conversation'))) {
155	        throw new Error('分享 API 回傳的不是可辨識的對話資料。');
156	      }
157	      return { kind: 'share', data, route: op.route, warnings: [], partial: false };
158	    } catch (error) {
159	      assertCurrent(op);
160	      if (controller.signal.aborted) throw new Error('分享 API 等待逾時。');
161	      throw error;
162	    } finally {
163	      clearTimeout(timer);
164	      op.controller.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
165	    }
166	  }
167	
168	  function pageTitle() {
169	    const title = (document.title || '').replace(/\s*\|\s*Shared Grok Conversation\s*$/i, '')
170	      .replace(/\s*[-–—|]\s*Grok\s*$/i, '').trim();
171	    return title && !/^Grok$/i.test(title) ? title : 'Grok conversation';
172	  }
173	
174	  function cleanClone(source) {
175	    const clone = source.cloneNode(true);
176	    const images = source.querySelectorAll('img');
177	    clone.querySelectorAll('img').forEach((image, index) => {
178	      const original = images[index];
179	      const src = original.currentSrc || original.getAttribute('src') || original.getAttribute('data-src');
180	      if (src) image.setAttribute('src', src);
181	    });
182	    for (const node of clone.querySelectorAll(NOISE)) node.remove();
183	    for (const node of [clone, ...clone.querySelectorAll('*')]) {
184	      for (const attr of [...node.attributes]) {
185	        if (/^on/i.test(attr.name) || attr.name === 'srcdoc') node.removeAttribute(attr.name);
186	      }
187	    }
188	    return clone;
189	  }
190	
191	  function domSnapshot(op) {
192	    const bubbles = messageNodes();
193	    // 換 URL 不等於換正文：寧可等待／報錯，不把舊泡泡貼上新對話 URL。
194	    if (!bubbles.length || bubbles.some(staleNode)) return null;
195	    const messages = [];
196	    const nodes = new Map();
197	    const warnings = [];
198	    for (const bubble of bubbles) {
199	      const parts = [];
200	      const roots = [...bubble.querySelectorAll(CONTENT_SELECTOR)].filter((root) =>
201	        root.closest(MESSAGE_SELECTOR) === bubble && !root.parentElement.closest(CONTENT_SELECTOR));
202	      for (const source of roots) {
203	        const clone = cleanClone(source);
204	        const placeholders = [...clone.querySelectorAll('.invisible.whitespace-pre-wrap')];
205	        const raw = placeholders.map((node) => node.textContent).join('\n\n');
206	        placeholders.forEach((node) => node.remove());
207	        const rendered = clone.textContent.trim() || clone.querySelector('img, pre, table, math');
208	        if (!rendered && raw.trim()) {
209	          parts.push({ format: 'markdown', content: raw });
210	        } else if (rendered) {
211	          const part = { format: 'html', content: clone.innerHTML };
212	          parts.push(part);
213	          nodes.set(part, clone);
214	        }
215	      }
216	      if (parts.length) {
217	        messages.push({ id: responseId(bubble), role: bubble.getAttribute('data-testid') === 'user-message' ? 'User' : 'Assistant', parts });
218	      } else {
219	        warnings.push('有訊息尚未載入或包含未支援的非文字內容。');
220	      }
221	      if (bubble.querySelector('.inline-media-container img, .inline-media-container video, .inline-media-container a')) {
222	        warnings.push('獨立附件區未匯出；目前只保留正文內可辨識的圖片與連結。');
223	      }
224	    }
225	    if (!messages.length) return null;
226	    return {
227	      kind: 'dom', route: op.route, nodes, warnings, partial: true,
228	      data: { schema: 'grok-loaded-dom-v1', source: 'grok', url: op.route.url, title: pageTitle(),
229	        capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(), export_scope: 'loaded-dom', completeness: 'partial', messages },
230	    };
231	  }
232	
233	  async function fromDom(op) {
234	    const deadline = Date.now() + DOM_TIMEOUT;
235	    for (;;) {
236	      assertCurrent(op);
237	      const capture = domSnapshot(op);
238	      if (capture) return capture;
239	      if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error('找不到可確認屬於目前對話的已載入訊息；請等待內容完成或重新載入頁面。');
240	      await delay(150, op.controller.signal);
241	    }
242	  }
243	
244	  async function acquire(op) {
245	    if (op.route.kind === 'share') {
246	      try { return await fromShare(op); }
247	      catch (error) {
248	        assertCurrent(op);
249	        panel.setStatus(`${error.message} 改用已載入 DOM（可能不完整）。`);
250	        const capture = await fromDom(op);
251	        capture.warnings.push(`分享 API 無法讀取，已改用 DOM：${error.message}`);
252	        return capture;
253	      }
254	    }
255	    return fromDom(op);
256	  }
257	
258	  function safeUrl(value, base) {
259	    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) return '';
260	    try {
261	      const url = new URL(value, base);
262	      return /^https?:$/.test(url.protocol) ? url.href : '';
263	    } catch { return ''; }
264	  }
265	
266	  function linkDestination(url) {
267	    return url.replace(/[()<>\\]/g, (char) => encodeURIComponent(char).replace(/\(/g, '%28').replace(/\)/g, '%29'));
268	  }
269	
270	  function escapeText(text) {
271	    return String(text).replace(/([\\`*_[\]])/g, '\\$1');
272	  }
273	
274	  /** 只轉換清理過的 clone；code／math 先保護，避免段落整理破壞內部空白。 */
275	  function htmlToMarkdown(root, base) {
276	    const protectedText = [];
277	    let prefix = '\u0000grok-code-';
278	    while (root.textContent.includes(prefix)) prefix += '-';
279	    const protect = (text) => `${prefix}${protectedText.push(text) - 1}\u0000`;
280	    const restore = (text) => text.replace(new RegExp(`${prefix}(\\d+)\\u0000`, 'g'), (_, i) => protectedText[Number(i)]);
281	    const tidy = (text) => text.replace(/\n[ \t]+(?=\n)/g, '\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
282	    const kids = (node) => [...node.childNodes].map(walk).join('');
283	    const block = (text) => `\n\n${text}\n\n`;
284	
285	    function walk(node) {
286	      if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) return escapeText(node.textContent);
287	      if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return '';
288	      const tag = node.tagName.toLowerCase();
289	      if (node.matches('.katex, .katex-display, math')) {
290	        const tex = node.querySelector('annotation[encoding="application/x-tex"]')?.textContent;
291	        if (tex) return node.matches('.katex-display, math[display="block"]') ? block(protect(`$$\n${tex}\n$$`)) : protect(`$${tex}$`);
292	      }
293	      if (tag === 'pre') {
294	        const code = node.querySelector('code') || node;
295	        const language = code.className.match?.(/(?:^|\s)language-([\w+#.-]+)/)?.[1] || code.getAttribute('data-language') || node.getAttribute('data-language') || '';
296	        return block(protect(fence(code.textContent, /^[\w+#.-]{1,30}$/.test(language) ? language : '')));
297	      }
298	      if (tag === 'code') {
299	        const text = node.textContent.replace(/\n/g, ' ');
300	        const size = Math.max(0, ...(text.match(/`+/g) || []).map((run) => run.length)) + 1;
301	        const ticks = '`'.repeat(size);
302	        const padding = /^[` ]|[` ]$/.test(text) ? ' ' : '';
303	        return protect(`${ticks}${padding}${text}${padding}${ticks}`);
304	      }
305	      if (/^h[1-6]$/.test(tag)) return block(`${'#'.repeat(Number(tag[1]))} ${kids(node).trim()}`);
306	      if (tag === 'br') return '\n';
307	      if (tag === 'hr') return block('---');
308	      if (tag === 'strong' || tag === 'b') return `**${kids(node)}**`;
309	      if (tag === 'em' || tag === 'i') return `*${kids(node)}*`;
310	      if (tag === 'del' || tag === 's') return `~~${kids(node)}~~`;
311	      if (tag === 'a') {
312	        const text = kids(node).trim();
313	        const url = safeUrl(node.getAttribute('href'), base);
314	        return url ? `[${text || escapeText(url)}](${linkDestination(url)})` : text;
315	      }
316	      if (tag === 'img') {
317	        const url = safeUrl(node.getAttribute('src') || node.getAttribute('data-src'), base);
318	        const alt = escapeText(node.getAttribute('alt') || 'image');
319	        return url ? `![${alt}](${linkDestination(url)})` : `[${alt}：圖片 URL 無法匯出]`;
320	      }
321	      if (tag === 'ul' || tag === 'ol') {
322	        const start = Number.parseInt(node.getAttribute('start') || '1', 10) || 1;
323	        const items = [...node.children].filter((child) => child.tagName === 'LI');
324	        return block(items.map((item, index) => {
325	          const marker = tag === 'ol' ? `${start + index}.` : '-';
326	          return `${marker} ${tidy(kids(item)).replace(/\n/g, `\n${' '.repeat(marker.length + 1)}`)}`;
327	        }).join('\n'));
328	      }
329	      if (tag === 'blockquote') return block(tidy(kids(node)).replace(/^/gm, '> '));
330	      if (tag === 'table') {
331	        const rows = [...node.querySelectorAll('tr')].filter((row) => row.closest('table') === node)
332	          .map((row) => [...row.children].filter((cell) => /^(TH|TD)$/.test(cell.tagName))
333	            .map((cell) => restore(tidy(kids(cell))).replace(/\|/g, '\\|').replace(/\n/g, '<br>')));
334	        if (!rows.length) return '';
335	        const width = Math.max(...rows.map((row) => row.length));
336	        const row = (cells) => `| ${Array.from({ length: width }, (_, i) => cells[i] || '').join(' | ')} |`;
337	        return block([row(rows[0]), row(Array(width).fill('---')), ...rows.slice(1).map(row)].join('\n'));
338	      }
339	      if (['p', 'div', 'section', 'article', 'figure', 'figcaption'].includes(tag)) return block(kids(node));
340	      return kids(node);
341	    }
342	    return restore(tidy(walk(root)));
343	  }
344	
345	  function baseDoc(capture) {
346	    const data = capture.data;
347	    const conversation = capture.kind === 'share' ? data.conversation || {} : {};
348	    return { source: 'grok', sourceLabel: 'Grok', title: typeof conversation.title === 'string' ? conversation.title : data.title || pageTitle(),
349	      url: capture.route.url,
350	      ids: { conversation_id: conversation.conversationId || (capture.route.kind === 'c' ? capture.route.id : ''), share_id: capture.route.kind === 'share' ? capture.route.id : '' },
351	      model: '', createdAt: conversation.createTime || '', sections: [] };
352	  }
353	
354	  function normalize(capture) {
355	    const doc = baseDoc(capture);
356	    if (capture.kind === 'dom') {
357	      doc.sections = capture.data.messages.map((message) => ({ role: message.role,
358	        body: message.parts.map((part) => part.format === 'markdown' ? part.content : htmlToMarkdown(capture.nodes.get(part), doc.url)).join('\n\n') }));
359	      return doc;
360	    }
361	    const data = capture.data;
362	    if (!Array.isArray(data.responses)) throw new Error('分享資料格式已變更；請下載原始 JSON 保存資料。');
363	    const seen = new Map();
364	    const warn = (text) => { capture.warnings.push(text); capture.partial = true; };
365	    for (const message of data.responses) {
366	      if (!message || typeof message !== 'object') { warn('有未支援的訊息格式，請下載原始 JSON。'); continue; }
367	      if (message.isControl) continue;
368	      if (message.sender !== 'human' && message.sender !== 'assistant') {
369	        warn('有未知角色／工具訊息未納入正文；原始 JSON 仍保留。'); continue;
370	      }
371	      if (message.responseId) {
372	        const serialized = JSON.stringify(message);
373	        if (seen.has(message.responseId)) {
374	          if (seen.get(message.responseId) !== serialized) warn('有衝突的重複 response ID，僅保留首次版本；請查看原始 JSON。');
375	          continue;
376	        }
377	        seen.set(message.responseId, serialized);
378	      }
379	      if (message.partial === true) warn('有尚未完成（partial）的回覆。');
380	      if (typeof message.message !== 'string') { warn('有未支援的非文字訊息，請下載原始 JSON。'); continue; }
381	      let body = message.message;
382	      const cited = (Array.isArray(message.citedWebSearchResults) ? message.citedWebSearchResults : [])
383	        .map((source) => ({ url: linkDestination(safeUrl(source?.url, doc.url)), title: escapeText(source?.title || source?.url || '') }))
384	        .filter((source) => source.url);
385	      const sources = sourcesBlock(cited);
386	      if (sources) body += `\n\n${sources}`;
387	      for (const field of ['generatedImageUrls', 'imageAttachments', 'fileAttachments', 'fileUris', 'fileAttachmentsMetadata', 'fileAttachmentAssetMetadata', 'fileIds', 'cardAttachmentsJson']) {
388	        const attachments = message[field];
389	        if (!Array.isArray(attachments) || !attachments.length) continue;
390	        for (const asset of attachments) {
391	          const rawUrl = typeof asset === 'string' ? asset : asset?.url;
392	          // 只接受明確的網路 URL，不能把 opaque file ID 當成網站相對路徑。
393	          const url = /^https?:\/\//i.test(rawUrl || '') ? safeUrl(rawUrl, doc.url) : '';
394	          if (!url) { warn('有未支援的附件參照未匯出；請查看原始 JSON。'); continue; }
395	          const image = field === 'generatedImageUrls' || field === 'imageAttachments';
396	          const label = escapeText(asset?.fileName || asset?.name || (image ? 'image' : 'attachment'));
397	          const link = `${image ? '!' : ''}[${label}](${linkDestination(url)})`;
398	          if (!body.includes(url)) body += `\n\n${link}`;
399	        }
400	      }
401	      if (!body.trim()) { warn('有空白或尚未載入的訊息。'); continue; }
402	      const model = typeof message.model === 'string' ? message.model : '';
403	      if (model) doc.model = model;
404	      doc.sections.push({ role: message.sender === 'human' ? 'User' : 'Assistant', model, time: message.createTime, body });
405	    }
406	    return doc;
407	  }
408	
409	  function renderGrokTranscript(doc, capture, handoff) {
410	    const markdown = renderTranscript(doc, { handoff, exporter: EXPORTER });
411	    const end = markdown.indexOf('\n---\n', 4);
412	    if (!markdown.startsWith('---\n') || end < 0) throw new Error('共用 renderer 格式已變更，無法安全加入匯出範圍。');
413	    const scope = capture.kind === 'dom' ? 'loaded-dom' : 'published-share-snapshot';
414	    const state = capture.partial ? 'partial' : 'unknown';
415	    const metadata = `\nexport_scope: "${scope}"\ncompleteness: "${state}"`;
416	    const notices = [capture.kind === 'dom' ? DOM_NOTICE : SHARE_NOTICE, ...new Set(capture.warnings)];
417	    const notice = notices.map((text) => `> ${text.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ')}`).join('\n>\n');
418	    return `${markdown.slice(0, end)}${metadata}${markdown.slice(end, end + 5)}\n${notice}\n${markdown.slice(end + 5)}`;
419	  }
420	
421	  async function doExport(mode) {
422	    reconcile();
423	    if (!route) { panel.setStatus('請開啟 Grok 分享頁或 /c/ 對話頁。'); return; }
424	    operation?.controller.abort();
425	    const op = { route: { ...route }, generation, controller: new AbortController() };
426	    operation = op;
427	    panel.setStatus('正在讀取目前對話…');
428	    try {
429	      const capture = await acquire(op);
430	      assertCurrent(op);
431	      if (mode === 'json') {
432	        // JSON 不經 normalize / renderer；新格式造成 Markdown 失敗時仍可取回來源。
433	        const doc = baseDoc(capture);
434	        const text = JSON.stringify(capture.data, null, 2);
435	        assertCurrent(op);
436	        downloadText(filenameFor(doc, capture.kind === 'dom' ? 'dom-snapshot.json' : 'json'), text, 'application/json;charset=utf-8');
437	        panel.setStatus(capture.kind === 'dom' ? '已下載 DOM snapshot（僅已載入訊息，非原始 API JSON）。' : '已下載原始分享 JSON（公開快照，含未納入 Markdown 的欄位）。');
438	      } else {
439	        const doc = normalize(capture);
440	        const text = renderGrokTranscript(doc, capture, mode === 'handoff');
441	        assertCurrent(op);
442	        if (mode === 'md') downloadText(filenameFor(doc, 'md'), text);
443	        else GM_setClipboard(text, 'text');
444	        panel.setStatus(`${mode === 'md' ? '已下載' : '已複製'} Markdown；${capture.kind === 'dom' ? 'DOM／僅已載入內容' : '公開分享快照'}${capture.warnings.length ? '（有部分內容限制，請看匯出說明）' : ''}。`);
445	      }
446	    } catch (error) {
447	      if (operation === op && !op.controller.signal.aborted) panel.setStatus(`匯出失敗：${error.message}`);
448	    } finally {
449	      if (operation === op) operation = null;
450	    }
451	  }
452	
453	  GM_registerMenuCommand('Copy Markdown', () => doExport('markdown'));
454	  GM_registerMenuCommand('Copy Agent Handoff', () => doExport('handoff'));

````markdown
# Grok Export Markdown

將 Grok 對話匯出為 Markdown、Agent Handoff 或 JSON，沿用 ChatGPT exporter 的浮動面板與 transcript 格式。

- **生效網站**：`https://grok.com/*`，功能僅在 `/share/<id>` 與 `/c/<id>` 啟用；涵蓋首頁是為了支援 SPA 導航。
- **安裝**：[點這裡安裝](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/main/userscripts/grok-export-markdown/grok-export-markdown.user.js)（Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey）
- **原始碼**：[`grok-export-markdown.user.js`](./grok-export-markdown.user.js)
- **測試紀錄**：[`VALIDATION.md`](./VALIDATION.md)

## 使用方式

1. 開啟 Grok 分享頁或一般對話頁，等待內容載入。
2. 點右下角 **⇩ Export MD**，選擇動作；manager 選單也有相同操作。
3. 面板可用滑鼠／觸控拖曳，位置會記住。`Reset button position` 可還原位置。

| 動作 | 輸出 |
| --- | --- |
| Copy Markdown | YAML frontmatter + `_**User**_`／`_**Assistant**_` 對話，複製到剪貼簿 |
| Copy Agent Handoff | 同上，加上給 coding agent 的前情提要指示 |
| Download .md | 相同 Markdown，下載為 `grok-<標題>-<時間>.md` |
| Download .json | 分享 API 成功時為原始 JSON；DOM 備援時為明確標記的 `.dom-snapshot.json` |

所有資料只在目前分頁擷取與本機複製／下載，不傳送到其他服務，不建立分享連結。僅記住按鈕位置，不在 GM storage 保存對話。

## 資料從哪裡來

### 公開分享頁

按下匯出時，以同源 GET `/rest/app-chat/share_links/<完整 share ID>` 取得網站的公開快照；不需 token、攔截 fetch 或 `unsafeWindow`。保留原始 Markdown 與回傳順序，將 `human`／`assistant` 對應為 User／Assistant。

請求失敗（HTTP 錯誤、非 JSON、逾時等）時，只備援擷取**目前同一分享頁**的已載入 DOM，並明示降級。不會拿其他對話的快取替代。

原始 JSON 下載不依賴 Markdown 正規化，因此即使網站改了訊息格式，仍能保存可辨識的原始回應供後續處理。JSON 會含有正文匯出省略的 thinking／tool 等欄位，分享檔案前請自行檢查。

### 一般 `/c/<id>` 對話

首版只擷取已載入 DOM，不猜測登入後的私人 API，也不自動捲動補齊歷史。尚未完成真實登入 session 的 live smoke，請以匯出內容與原頁比對。

DOM 會先複製再清理，排除角色標籤、thinking 區、sources 按鈕、表格工具按鈕及腳本自己的面板。保留可辨識的標題、列表、code fence、表格、連結、正文圖片與 LaTeX annotation；renderer 的原始 Markdown placeholder 不會被當成空白或重複轉換。

DOM JSON 是 `grok-loaded-dom-v1` snapshot，含 capture time、URL、角色、response ID 與清理後的 HTML／Markdown 片段，**不是 API 原始 JSON**。HTML 片段是資料，不應直接當作可信 HTML 插入其他網站。

## 匯出範圍與限制

Markdown、Agent Handoff 與 `.md` 都含可見說明及 frontmatter：

| `export_scope` | `completeness` | 意義 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `published-share-snapshot` | `unknown`，有未完成／省略內容時 `partial` | 僅網站回傳的公開快照，不保證完整私人歷史或所有分支 |
| `loaded-dom` | `partial` | 僅目前載入的訊息，未載入／收合／虛擬化內容可能缺漏 |

- 只匯出問答正文，不提供 thinking／tool 開關。已標記引用的可辨識 URL 才補為 Sources，不把全部搜尋候選結果當成引用。
- 私有 citation／widget 新格式可能原樣保留，未知訊息格式或附件參照會顯示限制；可下載原始 JSON 保存。
- 圖片與附件僅保留可辨識的網路參照，不下載附件或做 ZIP。DOM 的獨立附件區未支援；正文內的圖片可保留 URL。登入限定／有期限的 URL 不保證離線可用。
- 目前沒有對話樹、分支選取、archive、離線 viewer、任意 share URL 輸入或 X 內建 Grok 支援。
- 切換對話會取消尚未完成的匯出。若新 URL 仍顯示舊訊息而無法確認來源，會拒絕匯出並提示重新載入，不誤貼舊對話。
- 對話仍在生成時，DOM 可能只是當下的一部分；建議等回覆完成後匯出。API 的 `partial` 回覆會額外標示。
- 依賴 Grok 的非公開資料格式／DOM，網站改版可能失效；TM／VM 真實驗證與 fixture 證據分開記錄，不宣稱 Safari Userscripts 相容。
- `@require` 只載入 repo 共用 renderer 與面板；沒有新增第三方 runtime dependency 或跨域權限。

## 開發驗證

```bash
npm run test:grok-export
GROK_BROWSERS=chromium npm run test:grok-export
npm run verify
npm run preview -- grok-export-markdown "https://grok.com/share/bGVnYWN5_0031bed2-7d10-4f94-b312-51ba763328a8" --menu "Copy Markdown" --wait 20000
```

Preview 是 GM shim，不驗 manager 的 sandbox／grant／matching。匯出測試必須查看文字及下載 bytes，不能只看截圖。

  | （資訊截至 2026 年 10 月底，以 x.ai/pricing 與多方報導為準）
  | 
  | ### 免費版目前能用的主要功能
  | - **基本聊天（Chat）**：有限額度（官方只寫 Limited，沒公佈每天／每小時幾次）。可用於一般問答、寫作、即時網頁搜尋 + X 搜尋。
  | - **圖片生成（Imagine）**：有限額度（Limited）。
  | - **Grok Build**（寫程式／建應用等）：有限額度。
  | - **語音模式（Voice）**：有限額度（有自己的重置節奏）。
  | - **標準 X 功能**。
  | - 部分較輕量的模型／Fast 模式。
  | 
  | 免費額度與付費方案的「每週共享用量池」是分開的。付費用完後仍可回到免費額度繼續用（只是功能與速度會受限）。
  | 
  | ### 免費版沒有的／明顯受限的功能
  | - **影片生成**：沒有（從 Premium $30 起）。
  | - **Grok Bot**：沒有（從 Premium 起）。
  | - **最新旗艦模型**（如 Expert／Heavy／Grok 4.7 完整版）：通常鎖定付費。
  | - **Grok API 存取**：沒有（Plus 起才有，且 API 用量另計）。
  | - **高額度使用**：容易撞牆，尤其高峰時段。
  | 
  | ### 關於 Deep Research / DeepSearch
  | **還沒有完全消失**，但免費版已大幅受限。  
  | 早期（2025 年左右）免費用戶還能用一定次數的 DeepSearch／DeeperSearch，現在多半只剩很少量（有報導提到每天幾次等級，或乾脆很緊），完整深度研究與高額度主要留給付費方案。  
  | 如果你以前常用「Deep Research」功能，現在免費版體驗會明顯變差，這是很多人覺得「好像沒了」的原因。
  | 
  | ### 目前方案概覽（The X Subscription，2026 年 10 月後新用戶適用）
  | | 方案       | 月費   | 重點差異 |
  | |------------|--------|----------|
  | | **Free**   | $0     | 有限聊天、Imagine、Build、Voice |
  | | **Plus**   | $8     | 基礎共享用量池 + API + Cursor 等 |
  | | **Premium**| $30    | 4 倍用量 + Grok Bot + 最新模型 + 影片生成（最受歡迎） |
  | | **Super**  | $100   | 15 倍用量 + 優先權 |
  | | **Ultra**  | $200   | 50 倍用量 |
  | 
  | **總結**：  
  | 免費版還在，適合偶爾問問題、輕度使用。但 Deep Research／深度搜尋、最新模型、影片、Bot 等高階功能，幾乎都要付費才好用。官方從不公開免費精確額度，實際能用多少會隨負載調整，建議自己實際試用確認目前限額。
  | 
  | 如果想看最新官方比較，直接去 [x.ai/pricing](https://x.ai/pricing) 最準。

Base directory for this skill: /Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/Tampermonkey-Scripts/.claude/skills/userscript-development

# Userscript Development

Turn a page enhancement into a maintainable script and verify it at the layer
where it will run. The repo is the source of truth; a manager is an installation
and execution target. Use the workflow in any userscript project; read
[provenance](references/provenance.md) only when tracing its source evidence.

## Scope and defaults

- Use for `.user.js` development, review, troubleshooting, and browser testing.
- Default to Tampermonkey + Violentmonkey when no target is specified; record
  this assumption. Treat Safari Userscripts and Greasemonkey as separate targets.
- Preserve the project's build system and API style. For a small new project,
  start with a plain JavaScript IIFE and a directly installable `.user.js`.
  Adopt a bundler when dependencies or project requirements justify it.
- Use browser automation as a test driver here. A scheduled crawler or a
  browser extension's background/tab-management feature needs its own workflow.
- The bundled browser example requires Node 20+ and project-pinned Playwright;
  neither is a userscript runtime dependency. Real-manager tests also need the
  relevant official extension artifacts and an isolated browser profile.

## Installed-skill contract

- Resolve `US_SKILL_ROOT` from the directory containing the loaded `SKILL.md`,
  following its symlink if needed. References and assets are relative to that
  directory, regardless of which agent or project/global installation was used.
- Run project commands from the user's selected working project. Inspect its
  package scripts and layout first; no particular upstream checkout or sibling
  repository is required.
- Treat the installed skill as read-only. Copy examples into the working project
  before installing dependencies or running them; keep outputs there too.

## Workflow

- [ ] **1. Inspect the project and choose acceptance cases.** Read its agent
  instructions, metadata validator, scripts, fixtures, and recent validation
  records. Establish target URLs, manager/browser versions, frame scope, trigger,
  expected result, and how to undo the UI change. Infer routine choices from the
  repo; ask only about missing requirements that affect behavior.
  Use only commands that exist in the current project.
- [ ] **2. Establish metadata and the execution boundary.** Preserve script
  identity and existing URL scope. Map each required capability to a declared
  grant; distinguish DOM access from page-JavaScript access. Read
  [metadata and runtime](references/metadata-and-runtime.md) when adding APIs,
  changing timing, diagnosing injection, or adding a manager target.
- [ ] **3. Make the enhancement survive the page lifecycle.** Separate the
  persistent shell from route-specific state. Make reconciliation idempotent,
  bound observers, and invalidate stale asynchronous work. Read
  [DOM lifecycle and interaction](references/dom-lifecycle.md) for SPA changes,
  hotkeys, injected UI, focus, or cleanup.
- [ ] **4. Verify the actual output.** For a reader/exporter, read
  [content extraction](references/content-extraction.md): clone before cleaning,
  exclude owned UI, preserve a snapshot, and report partial results honestly.
- [ ] **5. Run focused automated tests.** Start with syntax and project checks;
  reproduce the relevant interaction in a local fixture. Read
  [browser testing](references/browser-testing.md) for browser installation,
  test pages, deterministic GM shims, screenshots, downloads, and test matrices.
  Fix failures and rerun the affected checks.
- [ ] **6. Exercise a real manager when that layer matters.** Read
  [manager and reference-extension testing](references/extension-testing.md)
  for persistent Chromium contexts, installing through manager UI, discovering
  extension IDs, Firefox limitations, and differential/coexistence tests.
  A shim pass does not complete this step. If the environment blocks it, finish
  independent checks and record the exact unverified cases.
- [ ] **7. Prepare the deliverable.** Bump an already distributed script's
  version for a changed release; regenerate indexes with repo tools; verify the
  raw install URL and dependency revisions. Report versions and evidence using
  the template below. Publishing follows the user's requested scope.

## Choose the test layer deliberately

| Layer | What it establishes | What remains outside it |
|---|---|---|
| Syntax / metadata / pure functions | Parsing, declared capabilities, transformations | Browser behavior and installation |
| Chromium + Firefox fixture with GM shim | DOM, keyboard, routing, UI, output, modeled GM calls | Actual grants, sandbox, manager storage and updates |
| Real manager on local HTTP fixture | Installation, matching, execution, storage, manager integration | Arbitrary sites and other browser/manager versions |
| Reference extension alone / script alone / together | Native baseline, intended differences, keyboard and UI coexistence | Complete equivalence of all extension capabilities |
| Requested live-site smoke | The named interactions on that site's current DOM | All routes, accounts, or future site versions |

## Gotchas

- **A synchronous `applying` flag does not stop observer feedback.** Mutation
  callbacks arrive later. Compare the desired DOM value before writing; make a
  second reconciliation do nothing. A trailing debounce can also starve forever
  on a streaming page; use bounded scheduling where progress must continue.
- **A DOM observer is not a navigation observer.** URL-only route changes can
  have no DOM mutation. Recheck route identity on actions and use a route signal
  supported by the target environment.
- **Page context is not guaranteed by a successful Console experiment.** A new
  grant can change execution context. `document-start` is a requested timing,
  not proof that the script beat every site script or dependency load.
- **`@require` consumers own their dependencies' grants too.** Static regex
  scanners can miss calls in helpers and dynamic access; inspect dependencies.
  A local harness may substitute the worktree file while a manager uses a
  cached remote revision.
- **One init-script call preserves shim → dependency → script ordering.**
  Separate Playwright init-script registrations have no guaranteed relative
  order. Direct injection still does not reproduce the manager's timing.
- **Reference data is not a running extension.** A copied command table verifies
  a model; actual extension coexistence requires loading the extension too.
- **The first extension worker might belong to the reference extension.**
  Discover and identify each installed artifact; don't hard-code store IDs or
  assume every extension uses a Manifest V3 service worker.
- **Headless clipboard success is not a system-clipboard check.** Use a headed
  session when that behavior is required and record what was actually observed.
- **CSS isolation is not keyboard isolation.** Shadow DOM events can retarget to
  the host. Check `composedPath()`, editable ancestors, IME, and key sequences.
- **Two installed copies can look like a lifecycle bug.** Confirm script ID,
  version, manager, and whether both a URL install and local tracking copy run.
- **No API family is universally portable.** `GM_*` and `GM.*` can differ in
  availability, naming, return values, and timing. Awaiting an absent API is
  still a failure; don't advertise Safari support from desktop tests.

## Bundled assets

Copy these three files together into a project's test-example directory when
setting up its first browser harness. Read [browser testing](references/browser-testing.md)
before adapting them; they demonstrate a fixture contract, not a universal shim.

- `assets/fixture.html` — local SPA test page with an input and a replaceable main.
- `assets/fixture-tools.user.js` — small installable counter/menu demonstration.
- `assets/fixture.test.mjs` — Node test runner + Chromium/Firefox, explicit GM
  shim, route isolation, DOM and storage assertions, screenshots, cleanup.
- `assets/.gitignore` — keep the copied example's `.artifacts/` outputs out of Git.

## Handoff template

```text
Changed: <script/file; user-visible behavior; version before → after>
Targets: <manager + browser versions; URL/frame scope>
Permissions/dependencies: <added/changed capabilities and reason>
Checks:
  Static/pure: <command + result>
  Browser fixtures: <engines + cases + result>
  Real manager: <installation path + cases + result, or unverified reason>
  Reference comparison: <artifact/version + baseline/difference/coexistence>
  Live site: <specific routes/actions, or not run>
Evidence: <test page, report, screenshot, output paths>
Install/update: <artifact/raw URL; dependency and version considerations>
Remaining limits: <specific untested behavior; no inferred pass>
```
