1	# Real managers and reference extensions
2	
3	Read when the requirement includes installing a userscript, validating sandbox or
4	GM behavior, matching a native extension, or checking coexistence. This workflow
5	was exercised in the source project; its versioned record is linked below.
6	
7	## 1. Prepare isolated artifacts
8	
9	Use official releases/store packages or a read-only copy of an already installed
10	official extension directory. Record origin, version, manifest version and hash.
11	Do not use a random repackaged download. Extension package files are sufficient;
12	do not clone a daily browser profile, cookies, or extension settings.
13	
14	Create a new test profile. Keep the manager and optional reference-extension
15	directories separate. Preserve upstream code and the manifest; if an unpacked
16	artifact has a different ID, discover that ID rather than modifying keys to force
17	the store ID. A CRX is not the unpacked directory expected by Chromium's flags:
18	use a verified unpacked release/build or a format-aware extraction tool, retaining
19	the original artifact. An XPI is a Firefox artifact, not a Chromium extension.
20	
21	## 2. Launch bundled Chromium with persistent context
22	
23	The official Playwright extension workflow uses bundled Chromium and a persistent
24	context. Regular `browser.newContext()` is not the extension-loading workflow.
25	Chrome/Edge release channels may not accept the sideload flags. Start headed when
26	debugging permissions, installation UI or system clipboard behavior; the bundled
27	`chromium` channel also supports headless extension tests.
28	
29	Setup fragment for a project-pinned Playwright runner. Set `US_MANAGER_DIR` and
30	optional `US_REFERENCE_DIR` to the user's unpacked artifacts; relative paths are
31	resolved from the working project. No particular browser profile directory or
32	author's machine is assumed:
33	
34	```javascript
35	import { chromium } from 'playwright';
36	import { mkdtemp, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
37	import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
38	import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
39	
40	if (!process.env.US_MANAGER_DIR) throw new Error('Set US_MANAGER_DIR to an unpacked manager');
41	const dirs = [process.env.US_MANAGER_DIR, process.env.US_REFERENCE_DIR]
42	  .filter(Boolean).map((path) => resolve(path));
43	for (const dir of dirs) {
44	  if (dir.includes(',')) throw new Error('Extension directories must not contain commas');
45	  const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(dir, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8'));
46	  console.log({ dir, version: manifest.version, manifestVersion: manifest.manifest_version });
47	}
48	const profile = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'userscript-manager-'));
49	const context = await chromium.launchPersistentContext(profile, {
50	  channel: 'chromium',
51	  headless: false,
52	  args: [
53	    `--disable-extensions-except=${dirs.join(',')}`,
54	    `--load-extension=${dirs.join(',')}`,
55	  ],
56	});
57	try {
58	  const page = await context.newPage();
59	  await page.goto('chrome://extensions/');
60	  // Identify loaded extensions, install through the manager UI, then run cases.
61	  // Keep this test free of GM shims and direct userscript injection.
62	} finally {
63	  await context.close();
64	}
65	```
66	
67	This is launch setup, not an installation test on its own. Keep the temporary
68	profile only while diagnosing; remove that specific profile after closing the
69	browser when evidence is saved. Do not commit profiles or extension binaries.
70	
71	## 3. Identify the installed manager and import the script
72	
73	1. Inspect the extension list and loaded artifact version. For Manifest V3,
74	   enumerate service workers, identify each by its own manifest/name/version,
75	   and derive its ID from its `chrome-extension://` URL. With multiple extensions,
76	   the first worker is not necessarily the manager. Worker startup may be delayed
77	   or suspended. Manifest V2/background-page extensions need a different discovery
78	   path; an absent worker is not proof that loading failed.
79	2. Inspect the current browser's extension detail UI for required user-script
80	   injection and site-access controls. Names and locations change by version.
81	   Enable only the test manager's required permissions in the isolated profile.
82	3. Open its options/dashboard using the actual installed ID and the manifest's
83	   options page, or its visible extension UI. Do not hard-code a store ID or
84	   assume Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey share editor paths.
85	4. Use the manager's supported file import or raw `.user.js` install flow.
86	   For a file chooser, start `waitForEvent('filechooser')` **before** clicking
87	   import, then `chooser.setFiles(scriptPath)`. Confirm/save through the real UI.
88	   If a manager has only an editor, inspect that editor's supported interaction;
89	   do not write private extension databases as a shortcut.
90	5. Confirm installed name/version/enabled status. Reload a matching local test
91	   page. Assert a distinctive DOM effect, actual GM setting persistence across
92	   reload, and relevant menu/clipboard/download behavior.
93	
94	Serve the fixture and optional raw script from a loopback HTTP server with the
95	correct content types. Bind to `127.0.0.1`, use an available port, avoid caching
96	stale scripts, and close it on every exit path. For a narrow production match,
97	record a temporary test-copy match change as described in
98	[metadata-and-runtime.md](metadata-and-runtime.md).
99	
100	If nothing injects, inspect version, matching, grants, permission toggles and
101	extension errors. Do not add a GM shim to make this test pass: that changes what
102	the test measures. Headless clipboard results do not establish native clipboard
103	delivery; use a headed, deliberate clipboard case without logging prior content.
104	
105	## 4. Compare a reference extension
106	
107	Use the same HTML, viewport, focus/scroll starting point, settings and key sequence
108	in three configurations, preferably fresh profiles:
109	
110	| Configuration | Question |
111	|---|---|
112	| Reference extension alone | What does this exact version actually do? |
113	| Userscript + manager | Does the intended subset behave as specified? |
114	| Reference + userscript + manager | Do focus, shortcuts and controls coexist? |
115	
116	For Vimium-like tools, useful cases include native `j` scroll, `f` link hints,
117	help/Escape ownership, typing `scripts` into the userscript's search field, and
118	native hint activation of a userscript control. Inspect observable outcomes—scroll
119	position, selection text, focused element, hint visibility—not only key dispatch.
120	Use browser input rather than page-created KeyboardEvent objects for native actions.
121	
122	Separate intended differences from regressions. A reference-only test proves
123	native behavior; a command catalog copied from an official artifact proves only
124	the static model. Keep reference settings unchanged when importing them into a
125	companion's preview. Do not assume a private extension bridge exists.
126	
127	Record version/hash, fixture, initial state, action, expected/actual result and
128	screenshots. A practical report distinguishes `pass`, `fail`, and `unverified`.
129	
130	## 5. Firefox and Safari boundaries
131	
132	Playwright Firefox DOM tests work with explicit GM shims. Chromium's extension
133	flags and `chrome-extension://` dashboard URLs do not apply to Firefox.
134	
135	For actual Firefox extension development, use Firefox's temporary-add-on workflow
136	or Mozilla's `web-ext` with a fresh profile and the correct official artifact:
137	
138	```bash
139	npx --yes web-ext@10.6.0 run --source-dir "$US_MANAGER_DIR"
140	```
141	
142	Use `web-ext --help`/current Mozilla documentation for binary/profile selection.
143	This launches a temporary add-on session; it is not a claim that Playwright can
144	automate that Firefox session. Multi-extension manager coexistence may need the
145	native browser UI or a separately validated automation driver. A loaded add-on
146	whose dashboard cannot be opened is **not** a successful userscript install.
147	Safari/iPad needs its own app, API and on-device validation path.
148	
149	## Evidence and official references
150	
151	- [Playwright extension guide](https://playwright.dev/docs/chrome-extensions)
152	- [Mozilla web-ext workflow](https://extensionworkshop.com/documentation/develop/getting-started-with-web-ext/)
153	- [Source project's versioned real-manager record](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/blob/d7525d2/userscripts/vimium-c-companion/VALIDATION.md)
154	
155	Reviewed 2026-09-09. The source record reports Chromium + VM/TM + Vimium C
156	coexistence; it explicitly leaves actual Firefox manager coexistence unverified.
157

```bash
python3 -I - <<'PY'
import pathlib, zipfile, io, struct, json
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/Tampermonkey-Scripts/.preview')
results=[]
for artifact,folder in [(root/'desktop-install/violentmonkey-2.49.0.zip', root/'desktop-install/extension'),(root/'vim-navigation-tampermonkey/tampermonkey.crx',root/'vim-navigation-tampermonkey/extension')]:
 b=artifact.read_bytes(); offset=0
 if b[:4]==b'Cr24':
  version=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,4)[0]
  if version==3: offset=12+struct.unpack_from('<I',b,8)[0]
  elif version==2: offset=16+sum(struct.unpack_from('<II',b,8))
  else: raise ValueError(version)
 z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(b[offset:])); bad=[];count=0
 for n in z.namelist():
  if n.endswith('/'):continue
  p=pathlib.PurePosixPath(n)
  if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts:raise ValueError(n)
  dest=folder/n
  if not dest.exists() or dest.read_bytes()!=z.read(n):bad.append(n)
  count+=1
 results.append({'artifact':str(artifact),'comparedFiles':count,'mismatches':bad,'manifestEqual':(folder/'manifest.json').read_bytes()==z.read('manifest.json')})
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
(root/'grok-export-manager/artifact-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
```

```mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile, writeFile, mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';

const root = new URL('../../', import.meta.url);
const out = new URL('./', import.meta.url);
await mkdir(new URL('downloads/', out), { recursive: true });
const files = ['shared/chat-export.js', 'shared/export-ui.js', 'userscripts/grok-export-markdown/grok-export-markdown.user.js'];
const bundle = (await Promise.all(files.map((file) => readFile(new URL(file, root), 'utf8')))).join('\n');
const url = 'https://grok.com/share/bGVnYWN5_0031bed2-7d10-4f94-b312-51ba763328a8';
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const report = { browser: browser.version(), url, shim: true, downloads: [] };
try {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ bypassCSP: true, viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.locator('[data-testid="assistant-message"] table').waitFor({ timeout: 45000 });
  await page.addScriptTag({ content: `window.__menus={}; window.__clipboard=''; const values={};
    function GM_registerMenuCommand(name,run){window.__menus[name]=run;}
    function GM_setClipboard(text){window.__clipboard=text;}
    function GM_getValue(key,fallback){return values[key]??fallback;}
    function GM_setValue(key,value){values[key]=value;}
    ${bundle}` });
  await page.locator('#grok-export-md-root > button').click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Copy Markdown', exact: true }).click();
  await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__clipboard.includes('published-share-snapshot'));
  const markdown = await page.evaluate(() => window.__clipboard);
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('| **Free**'));
  assert.ok(markdown.includes('[x.ai/pricing](https://x.ai/pricing)'));
  assert.doesNotMatch(markdown, /Worked for|65 sources|Copy table|Download table|⇩ Export MD/);
  await writeFile(new URL('api-copy.md', out), markdown);
  await page.screenshot({ path: new URL('panel-chromium.png', out).pathname });
  for (const [menu, extension] of [['Download .md', 'md'], ['Download .json', 'json']]) {
    const pending = page.waitForEvent('download');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: menu, exact: true }).click();
    const download = await pending;
    const path = new URL(`downloads/${extension === 'md' ? 'conversation.md' : 'conversation.json'}`, out);
    await download.saveAs(path.pathname);
    const text = await readFile(path, 'utf8');
    if (extension === 'md') {
      assert.ok(text.includes('published-share-snapshot'));
      assert.ok(text.includes('| **Free**'));
    } else {
      const data = JSON.parse(text);
      assert.equal(data.responses.length, 2);
      for (const response of data.responses) assert.ok(markdown.includes(response.message));
      assert.equal(data.responses[0].sender, 'human');
      assert.equal(data.responses[1].sender, 'assistant');
    }
    report.downloads.push({ menu, filename: download.suggestedFilename(), bytes: Buffer.byteLength(text) });
  }
  await page.evaluate(() => { window.__clipboard = ''; });
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Copy Agent Handoff', exact: true }).click();
  await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__clipboard.includes('# Prior Grok Context'));
  await writeFile(new URL('handoff.md', out), await page.evaluate(() => window.__clipboard));
  // 頁面已載入後，才擋住使用者匯出時的新請求，驗證真實 DOM 備援。
  await page.route('**/rest/app-chat/share_links/*', (route) => route.fulfill({ status: 503, contentType: 'application/json', body: '{}' }));
  await page.evaluate(() => { window.__clipboard = ''; });
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Copy Markdown', exact: true }).click();
  await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__clipboard.includes('loaded-dom'));
  const dom = await page.evaluate(() => window.__clipboard);
  assert.ok(dom.includes('目前方案概覽'));
  assert.ok(dom.includes('| **Free** |'));
  assert.ok(dom.includes('[x.ai/pricing](https://x.ai/pricing)'));
  assert.doesNotMatch(dom, /Worked for|65 sources|Copy table|Download table|⇩ Export MD/);
```
